producer_brief.topic_summary: Core PS104/20-2 recovered off West Antarctica (Klages et al., Nature 2020) contains intact 90-million-year-old fossilized root networks, pollen, and amber just 900 km from the South Pole.
producer_brief.core_dramatic_question: How did a lush temperate swampy rainforest survive four straight months of continuous polar winter darkness near the South Pole?
producer_brief.target_emotion_arc: Blinding polar awe -> scientific disbelief at warm roots inside frozen seabed mud -> deep-time wonder at a vanished green Antarctica.
producer_brief.audience_takeaway: Mid-Cretaceous CO2 levels (~1120-1680 ppm) kept Antarctic mean annual temperatures near ~12-13C with zero continental ice cap.

observed_evidence: RV Polarstern drill core PS104/20-2 from the Amundsen Sea shelf (~73.5S, paleolatitude ~82S) preserved CT-imaged root networks, conifer/fern pollen, and translucent amber.
Geochemical paleothermometry indicates ~12-13C mean annual air temperatures and ~19C summer warmth ~90 million years ago.
scientific_inferences: Dense high-latitude forest canopy required ice-free Antarctica and atmospheric CO2 exceeding 1000 ppm to prevent winter freezing during 4-month polar night.
illustrative_abstractions: Seamless match-cut transition from split sediment core cylinder into living 90 Ma Nothofagus-podocarp swamp forest.

anti_clone_declaration.why_not_previous_template: Breaks completely from dark indoor Karoo/Thermal chambers into blinding 7200K high-key Antarctic blue-white glacier daylight paired with golden-amber deep-time forest.

beats.narrative_claim: Amid blinding West Antarctic sea ice, a split drill core reveals intact tree roots still threaded through ancient soil.
beats.audience_emotion: Instant cognitive dissonance — tree roots at the bottom of the frozen world.
beats.audience_knows_vs_hidden: Viewer sees dark fibrous roots inside icy core; the amber droplet and living biome are still withheld.

beats.narrative_claim: Micro-CT scanning inside core PS104/20-2 uncovers golden conifer resin and 62 spore/pollen taxa just 900 km from the South Pole.
beats.audience_emotion: Investigative excitement as microscopic evidence locks in.
beats.audience_knows_vs_hidden: Viewer sees fossil amber and root architecture inside the cylinder before stepping through time.

beats.narrative_claim: Ninety million years ago, this exact latitude stood at 12-13C average warmth — a misty podocarp and tree-fern river forest.
beats.audience_emotion: Transportive wonder as blinding white ice dissolves into living green swamp.
beats.audience_knows_vs_hidden: Full living Turonian biome revealed, leading to the ultimate polar-night question.

beats.narrative_claim: Even through four unbroken months of South Polar winter darkness, extreme greenhouse warmth prevented a single ice sheet from forming.
beats.audience_emotion: Sublime cosmic scale — an emerald forest breathing beneath aurora-lit polar night.
beats.audience_knows_vs_hidden: Peak visual contrast as warm golden resin droplet catches aurora sky over dark water.

beats.narrative_claim: Buried beneath modern Antarctic ice lies physical proof of how radically CO2 rewrites an entire continent.
beats.audience_knows_vs_hidden: Fossil amber grain bridges straight back into the blinding white expedition trench.
